exercise.title: Low E and A strings: which notes come at once
exercise.why: The game keeps asking the notes on the two lowest strings, so the ones you find at once show what short rounds have done, and the ones you still count up to are the ones to practice next.

cells.text:
Press Start in the game below. The game names a note and a string: tap that note on the neck, then play it on your guitar.
Notice which notes your finger goes to at once, and which ones you still count up to.
